macro.regime: late-cycle hawkish hold confirmed (dot-plot flipped to a hike), war premium gone, AI/semis wobble
macro.narrative: Two binaries resolved and both leaned hawkish/cautionary even as the geopolitical tail collapsed. (1) The June 16-17 FOMC, Chair Warsh's first, held the funds rate at 3.50-3.75% on a 12-0 vote but delivered a hawkish surprise in the projections: the median dot for end-2026 jumped to 3.8% (from 3.4% in March), 9 of 18 members now pencil in at least one more hike this year and 6 see two — flipping the prior implied cut into an implied HIKE. Warsh, characteristically, submitted no dot of his own and pared the statement to ~130 words. (2) On June 15 the US and Iran announced a framework MoU — a 60-day ceasefire, reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, lifting of the US naval blockade, and a 60-day US license letting Iran sell oil internationally — followed June 21-22 by a 'roadmap' to a final deal within 60 days (the MoU is holding but under strain). That removed the dominant war premium: Brent collapsed to ~$77 and WTI to ~$74 (well below the ~$86 of a week earlier), a powerful forward-disinflationary impulse. But the combination of a hawkish dot-plot, a BofA rate-hike warning and a brutal Asian semiconductor session (KOSPI -~10%) triggered a sharp June 23 risk-off in US tech (S&P -1.4%, Technology sector -~4%, semis leading), even though equity funds had just logged a RECORD ~$55B risk-on inflow week (tech +$21.5B, an all-time weekly high) through June 17. Rates eased modestly on the oil de-rate and Iran de-escalation (10y ~4.49%, off the 4.67% May high) but the hawkish dots cap any rally; gold slid further to ~$4,136 and Bitcoin softened to ~$62.5k. Net: we stay modestly defensive — favoring USD/cash (rate support reinforced by the dots) and structurally-bid real assets over richly-valued, AI-concentrated equities (CAPE high-30s/low-40s, near-zero ERP) and historically tight credit — with the next swing factors the late-July FOMC, mid-July June CPI, and whether the Iran roadmap converts to a durable final deal.
